name: mindpm
description: Project memory and a control plane for AI coding agents. Tracks tasks, decisions, notes and session context, hands specced tasks to agents, and gates done behind independent verification and human acceptance. Includes a built-in Kanban board.

MINDPM_DB_PATH.description: Path to the SQLite database file

MINDPM_PORT.description: Port for the built-in Kanban board UI

MINDPM_HOST.description: Interface the Kanban UI binds to. Loopback by default; set 0.0.0.0 only to opt in (e.g. under WSL2 NAT)

claude_mcp_add: claude mcp add mindpm -e MINDPM_DB_PATH=~/.mindpm/memory.db -- npx -y mindpm
